source_9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_33/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION the four sources with identical schemas
unioned_4_5_7_9 = pd.concat([source_4, source_5, source_7, source_9], ignore_index=True)

# Join unioned dimension table with source_0 on ROW_WID

df = pd.merge(df, source_2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
df = pd.merge(df, source_3, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

df = pd.merge(df, source_8, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")
